purpose: Three concept covers for user selection; not wired into the application.

concepts.name: 方案一 · 双人同频
concepts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: square album artwork for oneBeat's background audio media card, lock screen, notification and control center. Deliver ONE finished 1:1 square cover, full bleed, opaque background, no device mockup, no comparison board.
Input image 1: the project's existing Chinese 同拍 / English ONEBEAT brand wordmark, exact identity and spelling reference. Input image 2: existing two helmeted comic mascots, character identity and drawing style reference.
Primary request: create an expressive but very readable 'two people on the same beat' branded music cover. Two original mascots shoulder to shoulder in the central upper half, matching their original faces, lime green and black helmets, purple and yellow clothing. Retain their cool understated expressions and bold ink silhouettes. Below them, integrate the actual large tilted two-line wordmark from image 1, Chinese 同拍 in coral orange and ONEBEAT in teal, keeping its distinctive chunky italic letterforms, black extrusion and exact spelling. Wordmark should occupy roughly 75% of the width and remain clear at thumbnail size. Characters and wordmark form one cohesive die-cut sticker silhouette with a cream keyline and small tight black printed shadow.
Backdrop: warm ivory paper with two very broad coral and teal rhythmic arcs behind the characters, few large clean shapes and generous breathing room; subtle printed grain and hand-ink warmth. No many tiny decorations. Coral orange, teal, cream, charcoal with original character colors. Friendly urban comic energy. Keep important artwork inside a 10% crop-safe inset, background to all edges, native square corners. No frame around the whole image, no extra captions, no BPM, no song titles, no notes of arbitrary text, no watermark.

concepts.name: 方案二 · 节拍唱片
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium square music cover art for oneBeat's background media card in lock screen, notifications and control center. Deliver ONE finished full-bleed opaque 1:1 square image, not a mockup or design sheet.
Input image 1: exact existing 同拍 / ONEBEAT wordmark and brand palette reference. Input image 2: existing comic brand style only; no characters in this particular design.
Primary request: a highly distilled 'pulse record' cover. A single oversized cream circular record with a coral orange center and a few bold charcoal concentric ring marks floats on a deep matte charcoal background. A chunky teal rhythmic arc and one simple coral impact stroke imply a synchronized pulse. This is graphic album illustration with beautiful ink and paper texture, not a photorealistic product render. Integrate the actual two-line brand wordmark prominently across the center of the record, preserving exactly Chinese 同拍 in coral and ONEBEAT in teal from reference 1, the italic block letterforms, heavy black outlines and dimensional black offset. Add a thin cream separator outline only as needed for clear contrast. Wordmark approximately 72% canvas width, unmistakable at 64px. Balanced generous negative space, strong simple silhouette, restrained tactile screen-print texture. Reference palette only: coral orange, teal, cream, charcoal. Large quiet corners suitable for rounded crops. All key shapes inside 10% safe inset. No tiny technical waveforms, no readable groove labels, no arbitrary typography, no BPM or 120, no playback buttons or UI, no extra slogan, no watermark.

concepts.name: 方案三 · 日落行进
concepts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: square illustrated album cover for oneBeat background audio, designed for lock screen and notification media art. ONE complete 1:1 square opaque full-bleed cover, no device mockup, no comparison layout.
Input image 1: existing Chinese 同拍 / ONEBEAT brand wordmark to integrate with exact spelling, colors and distinctive heavy italic typography. Input image 2: existing helmeted two-person mascots to retain identity and comic ink style.
Primary request: an inviting coastal sunset 'walking together to the same beat' cover in the app's warm hand-drawn comic world. A very large warm coral sun sits over a calm turquoise sea, an ochre promenade and broad cream sunset clouds; use a small number of bold color masses with hand-ink contours and subtle colored-pencil/print grain. Two existing mascots from image 2 walk in step side by side near the lower third, keep lime-green helmet / purple outfit on one and black helmet / yellow outfit on the other, simplified readable full body silhouettes. Integrate the actual brand wordmark from image 1 in the upper-center, Chinese 同拍 above ONEBEAT, as the dominant clean foreground graphic at about 72% canvas width. Coral Chinese lettering and teal English lettering with original black extrusion plus a thick cream keyline so it remains readable against the sunset. Keep the whole composition calm, iconic and uncluttered; brand and two walkers remain distinct at thumbnail size. Warm coral, golden orange, turquoise, cream and ink black. Critical artwork within 10% safe inset, artwork reaches all edges, native square corners. No new characters, no small incidental props, no fixed tempo or song title, no extra text, no watermark, no UI.
